name: Shuuen no Koushuu Denwa
source:
You find yourself inside an old, weathered phone booth.
After successfully making a call, you realize you can no longer get out...
Take on the role of the esteemed Professor Gojo and find a way to escape the phone booth.
Simple choices await you — and multiple endings lie ahead.

[From [url=https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/the-final-payphone-switch]Nintendo[/url]]
